channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Congresso se apressa para destravar pautas; Lula negocia com Alcolumbre
item.description: Congress is accelerating the voting of stalled bills before the parliamentary recess, while President Lula seeks dialogue with Senator Davi Alcolumbre to unblock key government priorities in the Senate. The negotiations take place in the week leading up to the official start of the 2026 electoral race, with a focus on securing legislative progress before the campaign begins.

item.title: Debate virou programa para jornalista, torcida e campanha fazer cortes
item.description: The debate between Tarcísio de Freitas and Fernando Haddad on Band featured few substantive exchanges and was primarily used to produce video clips for campaign purposes, emphasizing viral content over voter persuasion. Other debates held across the country that same Sunday followed the same pattern, prioritizing social media material over meaningful ideological discussion.

item.title: Tarcísio e Haddad fazem 1º debate nacionalizado, com dados e embates sobre PCC, tarifaço de Trump e privatizações
item.description: The debate between Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) and Fernando Haddad (PT) on Band focused on Trump's tariffs, the PCC, privatizations, and the nationalization of the race, with Haddad emphasizing federal government actions in São Paulo and Tarcísio initially rejecting, then adopting the strategy of linking the federal government to Lula. The exchange was data-driven, devoid of personal attacks, and followed a structured format with mediator and journalist questions, plus direct rebuttals.

item.title: Cinegrafista da GloboNews é retirado da cobertura do debate após dar cabeçada em repórter
item.description: A GloboNews cameraman was removed from coverage of the Band debate between Fernando Haddad and Tarcísio de Freitas after headbutting a reporter during a scramble for camera space in the event's backstage area. The assaulted reporter received medical attention at the network, remained on assignment, and intends to file a police report.

item.title: Marina Silva critica Tarcísio sobre tarifaço e diz que governador colocou boné de Trump
item.description: Marina Silva, Senate candidate for São Paulo from the Rede party, criticized Governor Tarcísio de Freitas for his stance on the U.S. tariff increases, saying he 'put on a Trump hat' by supporting protectionist measures. She argued that Brazil must maintain its commercial sovereignty and not submit to external impositions that harm national industry and workers.

item.title: Ao chegarem a debate, Haddad foca em 4 anos de governo de concorrente e Tarcísio fala de futuro
item.description: In the electoral debate, Fernando Haddad, the PT candidate, focused on criticizing his opponent's four years in office, highlighting alleged failures in the current administration. Meanwhile, Tarcísio de Freitas, the incumbent governor and Republicanos reelection candidate, directed his speech toward the future, presenting proposals and a vision of continuity for São Paulo.

item.title: Cinegrafista da GloboNews é expulso de debate da Band após agredir repórter
item.description: A GloboNews cameraman was expelled from the Band debate in São Paulo after headbutting a Brasil de Fato reporter, who suffered a bleeding nose and was treated by firefighters. The incident took place in the station's parking lot shortly before the debate between Tarcísio de Freitas and Fernando Haddad. Band security blamed the GloboNews employee and demanded his removal from the premises.

item.title: Coordenador da campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro critica jantar de Lula com Moraes: ‘imparcialidade’
item.description: Senator Rogério Marinho, coordinator of Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential campaign, criticized the dinner between President Lula and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre at the residence of Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes, arguing it compromises impartiality and the separation of powers. Marinho stated that political agreements should not be negotiated in the homes of STF ministers, particularly when those judges are involved in high-impact electoral investigations. He emphasized that judges should not act as partisan intermediaries or guarantors of congressional successions.

item.title: Vacina de sarampo é ‘consagrada’ e ‘fundamental’, diz Tarcísio após Eduardo fazer campanha antivacina
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas urged residents to get measles vaccinations amid a state outbreak, calling the vaccine proven and essential. He addressed criticism of ally Eduardo Bolsonaro, who promotes anti-vaccine campaigns in the U.S., by affirming vaccine safety and encouraging public participation in immunization efforts.

item.title: 'Estamos enfrentando': Lula trata fila do INSS na base do gerúndio
item.description: The Lula government faces widespread criticism over the growing backlog at the INSS, leaving millions of Brazilians waiting for benefits and pensions. Although the issue began under Bolsonaro — with 2 million people in the queue at its peak — the current situation is seen as one of the main failures of the Lula administration, worsened by delays and inefficiency in social security processing.

item.title: Tarcísio e Haddad participam do primeiro debate das eleições para governador em SP
item.description: The current governor of São Paulo, Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos), and former Finance Minister Fernando Haddad (PT) will participate in the first gubernatorial election debate, organized by Band, this Sunday at 8 p.m. The event marks the official start of the direct confrontation between the two leading candidates in the 2026 race.

item.title: Tarcísio e Haddad se enfrentam em primeiro debate pelo governo de SP
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) and former minister Fernando Haddad (PT) are facing off in the first debate for the São Paulo governorship in the 2026 elections, hosted by Band in partnership with TV Cultura, TV Gazeta, and Jovem Pan. The event takes place this Sunday, the 9th, marking the first direct confrontation between the two leading candidates for the state succession. Tarcísio arrived at the debate accompanied by the mayor of São Paulo.

item.title: Eleições 2026: Metrópoles repercute o 1º debate ao governo de SP. Siga
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) and Fernando Haddad (PT) face off in the first debate for the São Paulo gubernatorial race in the 2026 elections, held at Grupo Bandeirantes' studios. The event launches the open TV debate season across 12 states and the Federal District, featuring rules that grant candidates greater freedom to manage their time and move around the studio.

item.title: Quaest: Lula abre vantagem no Nordeste e Flávio lidera no Sul
item.description: Lula leads with 64% voting intention in the Northeast against 25% for Flávio Bolsonaro in a hypothetical runoff, according to Genial/Quaest poll. Another 9% of voters say they would not vote for either candidate. In the South, Flávio Bolsonaro leads, though specific margins for that region are not detailed in the excerpt.

item.title: Rivais há quatro anos, Tarcísio e Haddad se reencontram em debate da Band ao governo de São Paulo
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) and Fernando Haddad (PT) face off in the first debate of the 2026 São Paulo gubernatorial race, with Tarcísio leading in polls (48% vs 32%) and positioned as the favorite, while Haddad seeks to undermine his record and rally national Lula support. The debate airs on TV Band, with only the two candidates present due to congressional representation rules, and could decide the election in the first round — unlike 2022, which required a runoff. Both candidates will have open time in two blocks to emphasize their preferred topics, with journalist questions in the others.

item.title: Debate Band: Tarcísio e Haddad fazem primeiro confronto ao governo de SP; assista
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) and former Finance Minister Fernando Haddad (PT) face off in the first debate for the São Paulo gubernatorial race on Band, scheduled for 8 p.m. this Sunday, the 9th. Although taking place in the first round, the debate is treated as a runoff due to the absence of other candidates with congressional representation eligible for TV debates. Band begins live coverage at 8 p.m.

item.title: MPF investiga lentidão excessiva do INSS na análise de processos
item.description: The Federal Public Prosecutor's Office (MPF) has opened an inquiry in Amapá to investigate alleged excessive delays by the INSS in analyzing and granting pension and social benefits. The complaint is part of a broader national crisis in the social security system under President Lula, marked by electronic system failures, fraud, data leaks, and a backlog of nearly 3 million pending cases. Although the recent leadership change at INSS has reduced the backlog, the new management faces criticism for a high rate of benefit denials, raising suspicions of artificial case clearance.

item.title: MP Eleitoral pede que TRE barre candidatura de neto de bicheiro no RJ
item.description: The Rio de Janeiro Electoral Public Ministry urged the TRE-RJ to block the candidacy of João Drumond (PRD) for state deputy, citing alleged ties to organized crime through his family (grandson of bicheiro Luizinho Drummond and nephew of Vinicius Drumond), his role in the Imperatriz Leopoldinense samba school, and ongoing investigations by the MPF’s Gaeco. The action argues the candidacy risks criminal infiltration of the electoral process, relying on TSE precedents.

item.title: Ao lado de Eduardo Cunha, Flávio Bolsonaro participa de culto evangélico no Dia dos Pais
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) attended an evangelical service on Father's Day at the Mundial do Poder de Deus Church in São Paulo, alongside Eduardo Cunha and Dani Cunha. During the event, he offered a prayer asking for wisdom, courage, and health, emphasized the importance of family unity, and stated he aims to 'rescue our country,' referring to his father Jair Bolsonaro's house arrest as an 'injustice and persecution'.

item.title: Vaivém dos eleitores independentes prenuncia disputa indefinida até o fim
item.description: The 2026 Brazilian presidential election remains undefined due to the volatile behavior of independent voters, who shift support based on recent events. After Lula opened a 13-point lead over Flávio Bolsonaro in July, that advantage narrowed to just 3 points in recent polls, reflecting the president’s loss of traction amid investigations involving his son. The race is marked by a fragile balance, with small variations in polls determining the possible outcome.

item.title: Ximbinha se candidata a deputado e declara não ter bens ao TSE
item.description: Musician Ximbinha, known for the band Calypso, announced his candidacy for federal deputy from Pará under the PDT, but declared no assets to the TSE. He is 52, identifies as white, and stated he did not complete elementary education. The candidacy was announced last Friday (August 7).

item.title: Tarcísio e Haddad se enfrentam em debate na Band. Veja as regras
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) and former mayor Fernando Haddad (Workers' Party) will face off in the first televised debate for the 2026 São Paulo gubernatorial race, hosted by Band this Sunday (August 9). The debate will feature three blocks: mediator-led questions, journalist inquiries, and a final direct confrontation, with candidates given greater freedom to manage their time and move around the studio. Tarcísio will speak first in the opening block draw, while Haddad will have the advantage of speaking last in the final block.

item.title: Deputado dos EUA publica montagem de Lula sendo capturado como Maduro
item.description: Republican U.S. Representative Carlos Antonio Giménez shared on X an AI-generated montage depicting Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva with Nicolás Maduro's face, following Lula's alleged capture by the United States, holding a bottle of 51 cachaça. The post is part of a series of attacks by the congressman against the Brazilian leader, reinforcing polarized political narratives.

item.title: Lula vai a 64% no 2º turno no Nordeste, e Flávio avança a 56% no Sul; veja detalhes da Genial/Quaest
item.description: Lula leads in the Northeast with 64% against Flávio Bolsonaro in a potential runoff, while Flávio advances in the South with 56% against Lula. Nationally, Lula maintains 44% to 39% over Flávio, although Flávio’s gains in the South and Northeast fall outside the regional margin of error. Flávio also gains among men, voters with high school education, and non-Bolsonarist right-wing voters, while Lula loses ground among independents and those with higher education.

item.title: Agressões de Milei contra Lula devem ‘cessar imediatamente’, diz Mauro Vieira
item.description: Brazilian Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira stated that the attacks by Argentine President Javier Milei against President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva must cease immediately for the bilateral relationship between Brazil and Argentina to progress. He emphasized that Brazil views Argentina as a strategic partner and expects equivalent respect from Milei’s administration, noting that the restoration of ambassadors depends on ending the recent insults, which included calling Lula a 'convict' and 'thief' and criticizing the Supreme Court. Vieira also denied claims that Brazil funded international efforts against Argentina and said Sergio Massa’s visit to Brazil had no electoral motive.

item.title: Empoderado por emendas, Congresso se engaja menos com presidenciáveis
item.description: The National Congress is becoming less reliant on the president to deliver resources to electoral bases due to the growth of imposing parliamentary amendments, which guarantee execution regardless of support for the Planalto. With R$ 49.9 billion allocated in 2026 — including R$ 26.56 billion in mandatory individual and state-bank amendments — lawmakers have gained predictability in delivering funds to mayors and governors, reducing the need to prematurely back presidential candidates solely to secure future budget access.

item.title: Flávio chora lendo carta para Bolsonaro após Moraes barrar visita de Dia dos Pais
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro posted a video in which he appears crying while reading a letter to his father, Jair Bolsonaro, after Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes denied visitation rights for Father's Day due to a prior 30-day suspension of visits. He called the decision inhumane and said he continues to receive updates on his father's health through lawyers, despite lacking formal support from Centrão parties for his 2026 presidential campaign.

item.title: Flávio chora ao falar de Bolsonaro em culto com Eduardo Cunha
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) became emotional while speaking about former President Jair Bolsonaro during a Sunday worship service in São Paulo on Father's Day, an event also attended by former Chamber President Eduardo Cunha and federal deputy Dani Cunha. His participation highlights his alignment with the Bolsonarist base and his 2026 presidential candidacy.

item.title: Deputado dos EUA defende que Lula seja capturado assim como foi Maduro
item.description: U.S. Republican Representative Carlos Antonio Giménez advocated for the capture of Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva by the United States, likening him to Nicolás Maduro and sharing an AI-generated image depicting Lula in a similar detention scenario. Eduardo Bolsonaro shared the post, mocking the montage and claiming the PT cannot appeal to the TSE in this case. Giménez also labeled Lula as 'corrupt' and a 'communist criminal', criticizing his remarks about U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio.

item.title: QUEM VENCE em CADA CAPITAL DO BRASIL no SEGUNDO TURNO? Pesquisa em todas as capitas!
item.description: Polling across all Brazilian state capitals shows highly competitive runoff scenarios, with center-left and center-right candidates leading in different regions. In São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, and Belo Horizonte, left-aligned candidates maintain an advantage, while in Northeastern and Northern capitals such as Salvador, Recife, and Manaus, there is a technical tie or slight edge for right-wing candidates. Economy, security, and health are the most recurring themes in local campaigns.

item.title: Empresa de filhos de Tarcísio não deve ser alvo de Haddad em debate
item.description: Fernando Haddad's campaign decided not to raise in the first televised debate the case of the company opened by Governor Tarcísio de Freitas' sons, despite considering the situation 'strange'. Haddad intends to wait for more information before addressing the topic, drawing a parallel with investigations against President Lula's son. The debate strategy will focus on a narrative dispute over Tarcísio's first term.

item.title: Flávio publica carta no Dia dos Pais após Moraes negar visita a Bolsonaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro published a letter to his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, on Father's Day, after Justice Alexandre de Moraes denied a visit to the former president. The message, shared on social media, reinforces familial and political support amid judicial restrictions.

item.title: Após Moraes negar visita, Flávio Bolsonaro escreve carta para Jair e chora
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro posted a video reading an emotional letter to his father, Jair Bolsonaro, after being barred from visiting him by Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes. The act took place on Father's Day and was shared on social media, where the senator cried while expressing longing and outrage over the prohibition of family contact.

item.title: Milei precisa ‘parar as agressões’ a Lula, diz Mauro Vieira
item.description: Brazil’s Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira said Argentine President Javier Milei must stop attacking Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva for bilateral relations to return to normal. Speaking to Argentine newspaper Clarín in an interview published March 9, Vieira emphasized that a gesture from Milei is needed to restore dialogue. The comment reflects Brazil’s concern over the escalating hostile rhetoric between the two leaders.

item.title: Depois do ‘nunca antes’, Lula recorre ao ‘quem nunca’ — e o efeito é cômico
item.description: President Lula used the phrase 'who has never asked a friend for a loan?' to defend his former chief of staff, Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro (Marcola), after reports that Marcola received money from a businesswoman with private interests before the government. The argument attempts to normalize the behavior through a rhetorical appeal to common experience, but is seen as comic and inappropriate, as it overlooks the clear potential conflict of interest. Lula’s defense contrasts with his usual rhetoric of exceptionalism ('never before'), revealing an effort to downplay an ethically questionable episode.

item.title: POR QUE LULA vai PERDER a ELEIÇÃO apesar de APARECER na FRENTE das PESQUISAS
item.description: The video argues that although Lula leads in polls, he may lose the 2026 election due to erosion of his base, growing dissatisfaction with the economy and security issues, and a potentially more effective mobilization by the opposition. It emphasizes that polls do not fully capture electorate volatility or the impact of unforeseen events.

item.title: Flávio participa de culto de Dia dos Pais ao lado de Eduardo Cunha
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro attended an evangelical service in São Paulo on Father's Day alongside Eduardo Cunha, expressing sorrow over being barred from visiting his father, Jair Bolsonaro, due to a ruling by Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes. He urged the faithful to cherish family bonds, calling the visitation ban inhumane and unjust.

item.title: Flávio faz cobrança pública a Campagnolo por apoio a Carluxo
item.description: State deputy Ana Campagnolo (PL-SC) posted a video alongside Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, but received a public demand from him to record a statement supporting his brother, Carlos Bolsonaro’s, Senate campaign in Santa Catarina. The request came after the video was shared on social media, highlighting internal family pressure within the Bolsonaro clan to align political endorsements.

item.title: Corrida pela Democracia leva esporte, inclusão e cidadania ao Autódromo Internacional de Brasília
item.description: The first Democracy Race gathered around 900 participants at the Nelson Piquet International Autodrome in Brasília, closing the National Week of the Electronic Voting System. Organized by the Superior Electoral Court (TSE), the event promoted citizenship, inclusion, and democratic participation, featuring experienced athletes, first-time runners, people with disabilities, and families celebrating Father’s Day.

item.title: O pôquer verbal de Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro quando o assunto é o ajuste fiscal
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan faced pressure from financial market agents in São Paulo meetings to reveal post-2026 election fiscal adjustment plans, as the general government gross debt reached 81.9% of GDP in June 2024 — near critical levels seen during Bolsonaro's pandemic-era management. While Durigan states the government continues improving fiscal trajectory with R$17.9 billion blocked in the budget, Lula's campaign avoids announcing spending cuts before the election, waiting to assess post-election political strength and congressional composition. Senator Flávio Bolsonaro is cited as Lula's main rival in polls, though his fiscal stance is not detailed in the excerpt.

item.title: Ao lado de Cunha, Flávio chora durante culto de Valdemiro para Dia dos Pais
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), a 2026 presidential candidate, attended a service at the Mundial do Poder de Deus church led by Pastor Valdemiro Santiago in São Paulo, where he was seen crying emotionally. Former deputy Eduardo Cunha, a candidate for the Federal Chamber from Minas Gerais, was also present at the event held this morning in honor of Father's Day.

item.title: Genial/Quaest: Lula lidera entre mulheres em todos os cenários de segundo turno
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva leads among female voters in all second-round scenarios for the 2026 elections, according to the Genial/Quaest poll. Lula's advantage among women remains consistent regardless of his opponent in the runoff.

item.title: ACM Neto declara R$ 85 milhões em patrimônio ao TSE, mais que o dobro de 2022
item.description: ACM Neto, candidate for governor of Bahia from the União party, declared R$85 million in assets to the TSE in 2026, more than double the R$42 million reported in 2022. The increase was driven by financial investments, which rose from approximately R$20 million to R$52 million, with significant allocations in funds (R$32.3 million), fixed income (R$19.7 million), and corporate participations (R$14.6 million).

item.title: Em congresso, Renan Santos chama Moro de "um rato, fraco, derrotado"
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential candidate for the Missão party, called Sergio Moro a 'rat, weak, defeated' during a congress in Curitiba, criticating his current stance after previously praising his role in Operation Lava Jato. He also attacked Deltan Dallagnol, calling him a 'rodent' and 'vagabond'. The remarks were made amid boos and insults directed at Moro by the audience.

item.title: Proibido de visitar o pai, Flávio Bolsonaro escreve carta: "Até breve"
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL presidential candidate, wrote an emotional letter to his father, Jair Bolsonaro, on Father's Day, expressing longing and hope after being barred from visiting him by a Supreme Court order from Justice Alexandre de Moraes. The restriction, part of a 30-day measure suspending non-essential visits to the former president, was upheld due to Flavio’s violation of court orders, including sharing his father’s letters on social media. In the letter, Flávio also noted the campaign’s progress, stating they had secured strong electoral slates in nearly all states with support from centrist party leaders, despite lacking formal endorsements.

item.title: Flávio escreve carta a Bolsonaro no Dia dos Pais: “Não poderei te dar um abraço”
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) shared an emotional video on Father's Day, appearing in tears while writing a letter to his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro. He revealed that his request to visit his father was denied, so he cannot give him a physical embrace and can only follow the situation from afar. The video, posted on Sunday, June 9, sparked widespread reaction on social media.

item.title: O avanço das investigações contra Lulinha no STF e as novas revelações a caminho
item.description: Investigators recently received a dossier indicating that businessman Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, is being financially supported in Spain by a construction company with billion-dollar contracts in the Lula government, according to Federal Police sources. The material submitted to the STF is described as devastating for Lulinha and may also implicate President Lula, who might need to replace a key government aide amid ongoing investigations into his allies.

item.title: Flávio participa de culto no Dia dos Pais com Eduardo Cunha e se emociona ao falar de Bolsonaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) participated in an evangelical service on Father's Day in São Paulo, where he became emotional when mentioning he could not visit his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, under house arrest. He prayed for wisdom and strength for his father, criticized Minister Alexandre de Moraes' decision denying family visits, and defended the right of parents and children to embrace, calling the ban inhumane. The event was attended by Eduardo Cunha and Dani Cunha and livestreamed on Flávio's social media.

item.title: Atacar urnas e vacinas é tão golpista quanto roubar grana via zap
item.description: TSE President Nunes Marques defended the legitimacy of Brazil's electoral system, stating that discrediting voting machines and vaccines is as undemocratic as corruption through messaging apps. He emphasized that questioning the electoral process discourages citizen participation in what he called Brazil's greatest democratic celebration. The statement comes amid rising attacks on election integrity and public health in Brazil.

item.title: Quaest: Lula ganha de Flávio Bolsonaro no Nordeste e entre mulheres
item.description: In a potential runoff between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, Lula leads nationally with 44% to 39%, though the margin is within the poll's error range. His strongest support comes from the Northeast (64% vs 25%), women (47% vs 35%), younger and older voters, and low-income households (up to two minimum wages: 54% vs 30%). Flávio leads in the South (56% vs 29%), among men (44% vs 40%), and in higher income brackets.
